Class Levels

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.Levels
public final class Levels extends Object
Player levels from whichever leveling mod the server runs, as Economies is for money: one way for every Tempest plugin to read a player's level, give leveling XP and hear about level-ups, without depending on the mod. Endless Leveling is found by itself when it is installed; another leveling mod (or its bridge) can register(Levels.Leveling) its own. Since API_VERSION 14; dungeon, wave gate and raid clears since 15. Leveling XP is raised by the Boosts.LEVELING_XP boost (Tempest Events, rank perks, boosters) when the mod lets Core do it. 
Levels.Leveling leveling = Levels.get();
if (leveling != null && leveling.level(player) >= 20) { ... }

Levels.listen(new Levels.Listener() {
    public void levelUp(UUID player, int oldLevel, int newLevel) { ... }   // the server thread: keep it quick
});
